summary: R's kernel time (7.5-8.2 us, flat T=1..32 in profile 30027c28212946fd) is fixed latency, so a latency cut is reasonable, but 7.6 -> ~3.5 us is optimistic: per-warp top-8 keeps the same serial shuffle depth and removes ~14 of 16 block barriers. Realistic 1.5-3 us per T<=32 shape (+1-2% at decode_1/verify_1, likely within noise at decode_16/32). Proceed with no companions, with an old-vs-new and pdl 0/1 A/B inside prepare().
justification: R rows 7.6/7.8 (decode_1), 7.6/8.2 (decode_16), 7.5/7.9 (decode_32), 7.6/7.7 (verify_1) do not depend on T: a serial chain in one block (RMSNorm reduce, top-8 loop, threadfence + atomic ticket, last-block align with padding scans). (a) per-warp top-8 still ~80 dependent shuffles but 2 barriers instead of 16: ~0.5-1 us. (b) PDL between P and R is a real adjacency (_dl_forward launches P then R): firing launch_dependents after P's K loop hides R's launch gap and norm_w/bias loads, ~1-2 us, visible in the shape total, while R's own row grows by the griddepcontrol.wait time. (c) Binary search over padding slots helps only at bsm=16 (T=32), <0.5 us elsewhere. Incumbents: sliding/full decode_1 127.5/142.9, verify_1 190.8/192.4, decode_16 205.0/349.5, decode_32 245.8/529.7 (the hypothesis quotes stale 132.7/142.6). verify_16/32 are the in-run flat control. Correctness of (a): route_key unique per expert, so the global top-8 of per-warp top-8s gives the same ordered set; keep NaN handling identical.
confounders: small-t-launch-minimal-dense-chain-pdl (parent, master): (b) depends on dl['pdl']; read the pdl and PATH CHOSEN = DENSE-CHAIN lines. Shared TU: a compile error drops all of stage 1 to master.
marlin-block-m-cap-16 (master): sets bsm, so the size (not sign) of (c) at decode_32.
stack-align-par-sidestream-sliding1 (master): moves decode_1 denominators; no confound.
post-expert-norm-triton-small-t, sglang-pipeline-parity-router-hilo-m8, fa3-hdim128-head-pairing-batched: not adjacent to P->R.
interference: No companion. Build requirements in prepare(): (1) keep master's R as dl_route_norm_align_v1 for timing only and print CUDA-event times for old and new R at T=1, 8, 32; (2) print the P->R pair captured in a CUDA graph replayed with pdl 0 and 1; (3) print R with and without the binary-search pad loop at T=32, or state bsm. No gate interaction with dense-chain-stage2-attn-side-pdl (keeps DL_MAX_TOKENS; stage 2 uses DL2_MAX_TOKENS); textual/build coupling only: both edit _DL_CUDA and _build_dense_chain; whichever lands second needs a 3-way restack keeping v2/-lineinfo and P's launch_dependents.
rules_flags: Only prepare-constant weights (norm_w, bias) before griddepcontrol.wait; local_start, ei, logits after.
Prepare-time A/B is fine; no host syncs in kernel_fn; PDL flag a prepare() decision.
First run an okc check; -lineinfo; sync+print after the new R in the self-check.
